quotes_zh.text: 在這個世界上，我們於苦難中纏結
quotes_zh.author: 伊馮那·塞赫

quotes_zh.text: 你和我是一樣的，艾斯維爾，我們是一張白紙的兩面。
quotes_zh.author: 莫夫·奇萊

quotes_zh.text: 你必須要理解你所追求的真實。
我會在永恆的另一側等待著你。
quotes_zh.author: 艾爾菲羅斯·赫利烏斯

quotes_zh.text: 你也許選擇了一條不曾有他人走訪的道路，但千萬得謹記那屬於你的責任不可輕易拋於身後。
quotes_zh.author: 佩斯特·尼傑

quotes_zh.text: 一個分裂的世界，四分五裂得沒人有機會拼湊得起，仍去嘗試的話有甚麼意義呢?
quotes_zh.author: 賽蒙·羅傑斯

quotes_zh.text: 你好啊，我是U.E.P，你叫我小U就可以了!
quotes_zh.author: U.E.P

quotes_zh.text: 夢幻；虛幻；玄幻；奇幻；眩亂；虛實交界的世界，你又如何定義是與非呢?
quotes_zh.author: 萊斯特·杜恩

quotes_en.text: Together, in this world. We are entangled in misery.
quotes_en.author: Yvonne Sehor

quotes_en.text: You are the same as me, Xavier. We are but the two sides of a paper.
quotes_en.author: Molf Carrie

quotes_en.text: You must realize the reality you're pursuing.
I will be waiting for you at the other end of eternity.
quotes_en.author: Alphrous Harius

quotes_en.text: You might have chosen a path where no before man had, but you must not leave your responsibility in oblivion.
quotes_en.author: Paster Nigel

quotes_en.text: A shattered world, so fracture that nobody is capable to repair. Why matter doing so?
quotes_en.author: Simon Rogers

quotes_en.text: Hello! My name is U.E.P, and you can call me U.
quotes_en.author: U.E.P

quotes_en.text: A dreamlike world, riddled with illusion—where fantasy dazzles and truth loses its shape. In such a place…by whose will is right separated from wrong?
quotes_en.author: Lester Dunn
